title: Cell record
description: JSON Schema for a cell-record — the triple (cell, value, t) pairing a predication-cell with the bilattice-value some valuation assigned at that cell, carrying a transaction-id. The cell and value are sibling fields, never merged. cell-record is a distinct structure from predication-cell: the cell is invariant position; the cell-record is a (position, value, time) snapshot under a chosen valuation.

cell.description: The predication-cell position. References library/predication-cell/predication-cell.schema.json by structural copy. Carries no value of its own.

value.description: The bilattice-value at this cell under the recording valuation. Sibling to cell, never merged into it.

t.description: ISO-8601 transaction-id. Together with the cell, content-addresses the row.

stratum.description: Optional stratum tag recording the cell-record's settling step: 'asserted' (stratum-0, in-flight input), 'saturated' (stratum-1, σ-fired), or 'settled' (stratum-2, Δ-stabilized).

derived-from.description: Optional list of cell-ids of prior rows this record was derived from. Records dependency under the closure-rule that fired.

derived-via.description: Optional gerund-slug naming the closure-rule or algebraic operator that produced this record from its derived-from set.
